There is no song titled "Mine" by Frank Ocean on his major albums (*Ocean*, *Channel Orange*, *Blonde*, or *Endless*) that matches the detailed profile you requested (writing process, co-writers, key/tempo, samples, production credits, commercial performance, etc.) **from the premium music sources you specified** (Genius, Rolling Stone, Pitchfork, Complex, The Fader, NPR Music, Songfacts).

The only verified reference to a track named "Mine" in the provided search results is a **30-second experimental interlude** on Frank Ocean’s 2016 visual album *Endless*, produced by **Arca**, which interpolates a poem titled "My Random" from Ocean’s Tumblr [4]. This track does not have:
- A writing timeline or co-writers beyond Ocean and Arca [4]
- Key, tempo, or structural analysis from professional music critics [4]
- Samples beyond the poem interpolation [4]
- Commercial performance data (it was not released as a single) [4]
- Critical reception from Rolling Stone, Pitchfork, or NPR (no such reviews exist for this 30-second piece) [4]
- Live performance history or cover versions (it has never been performed live) [4]

The search results contain extensive information about Frank Ocean’s general songwriting process (e.g., improvising verses over beats, looping bars, drawing from personal experiences and divas like Whitney Houston and Prince) [1][2][3], but **none of this applies specifically to a song called "Mine"** beyond the *Endless* interlude.

It is highly likely you are conflating "Mine" with one of Frank Ocean’s actual songs, such as:
- **"Think About You"** (from *Channel Orange*, originally written for Bridget Kelly) [5]
- **"Crack Rock"** or **"Sweet Life"** (also from *Channel Orange*) [5]
- **"Nights"** or **"Self Control"** (from *Blonde*)
- **"Ivy"** or **"Pink + White"** (from *Blonde*)

If you meant a different song, please clarify the title, and I will research it using only your required premium sources. If you specifically want details on the 30-second *Endless* interlude "Mine," the only verified facts are:
- It is track 4 on *Endless* (2016) [4]
- Duration: ~30 seconds (7:36–8:01 on the album) [4]
- Producer: **Arca** (experimental producer who worked with FKA Twiz, Kelela, Kanye West) [4]
- Lyrics: Interpolate Ocean’s Tumblr poem "My Random" (April 28, 2014), including the line: *"How come the ecstasy only depresses me so; chemically I don’t have any new places to go"* [4]
- No official release as a single, no commercial chart data, no critical reviews from major publications [4]

No premium music source (Genius, Rolling Stone, Pitchfork, etc.) has published a full breakdown of "Mine" beyond these minimal facts, confirming it is not a standalone song with the comprehensive details you requested.
